lines.en: Um, you haven't told these guys what they're doing in the wedding yet.
Um, well, they're not in the wedding.
I'm sorry, you guys, but, you know, Mike's got his brother and his friends from school,
so, you know, you were, you were, if it helps, you were next in line.
You just, you just missed the cut.
This is like figure skating team all over again.
I mean, I mean the balance beam.
Yeah, look, about tomorrow, I've got a question for you.
I just found out that one of my groomsmen had an emergency and can't make it.
And I was wondering if, you know, maybe one of you guys.
You both want to do it?
Um, there's only room for one.
I look great in a tux and I will not steal focus.
Um, you know, I really don't feel very comfortable making this decision.
You know, Phoebe knows you better.
I'm going to let her choose.
Well, if Phoebe's choosing, then say hello to Mike's next groomsman.
But I will need a mirror.
Is that what they say on the figure skating team?
You have to choose one of us to be in your wedding.
One of his groomsmen fell out.
I can't choose between you two.
I love you both so much.
Just not enough to put us in the original wedding party.
Um, listen, I have a very special bridesmaid task for you to do.
Well, there's a spot open for only one groomsman
and you have to choose between Ross and Chandler.
I don't, I don't, I don't want to do that.
All right, I guess I have to find a new bridesmaid.
Well, uh, you have fun tonight.
I know why I'm being such an ass.
I'm not supposed to tell you.
I'm not supposed to tell you.
You told us both we could be in the wedding?
Well, in my defense, you weren't supposed to tell each other.
Rachel, only one of us can do it.
I'll tell you at the wedding.
I don't know which one of you guys to pick.
Oh, good, because I had an idea.
I thought it would be fun if the third groomsman was my family dog, Chappie.
Well, this is a tough one.
I think I'm going to have to go with the dog.

So, technically, would this person be in the wedding?
I mean, aren't you scared of dogs?
I'll just take little Chappie and...
He can sense my fear and my throat is exposed.
Well, I guess I'm in the wedding then.
I repeat, level one, this is not a drill.
I'm still ordained from your wedding.
You think I'd give up being a minister and start paying to ride the subway?
Ministers don't ride the subway for free.
I had to read the Bible pretty carefully, but, yeah, we do.
Okay, if Joey does a ceremony, then we have to find someone else to walk Phoebe down the aisle.
Okay, Mike and Joey, get in position.
